description: Every reason code that can appear in a published ledger, other than the gate codes (plausibility.*, nameplate.*, elevation.*, agreement.*), which are registered with their messages in gates.spec.json. A code that is emitted but not listed here fails the test suite, so the proposer, the verifier and the reconciliation page can never disagree on what a rejection means.

codes.ingest.duplicate_interval: An interval for this window was already judged; the repeat is recorded and never counted twice.
codes.ingest.out_of_order: The interval starts before the last judged interval; late data is recorded, never inserted into a closed window.
codes.ingest.overlap: The interval starts before the latest interval judged here ends (a change of dt_s, or an interval inside another); it is recorded, never counted, and the batch it falls in is unaffected.
codes.ingest.site_mismatch: The interval names a site_id or node_id other than the one this gateway assembles; it is recorded, never counted, and the batch it falls in is unaffected.
codes.ingest.off_grid: The interval's timestamps are not canonical UTC (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ), its ts_start is not a multiple of dt_s from the epoch, or its ts_end is not ts_start + dt_s; it is recorded, never counted.
codes.ingest.spec_mismatch: The node judged this interval under a different gate-spec version than the engine running here.
codes.ingest.schema_invalid: The record does not validate against interval.schema.json.
codes.ingest.not_integer: A numeric field is not a safe integer; evidence is integers only.
codes.ingest.raw_missing: The interval reached the door without the raw payloads it was built from; it is recorded, never counted, and the batch it falls in is unaffected.
codes.ingest.raw_mismatch: The raw payloads that came with the interval are malformed or do not hash to its source.raw_sha256; it is recorded, never counted, and the batch it falls in is unaffected.
codes.batch.schema_invalid: The batch does not validate against batch.schema.json.
codes.batch.hash_mismatch: sha256 does not equal the hash of the canonical batch.
codes.batch.root_mismatch: intervals_root does not equal the Merkle root of the contained intervals.
codes.batch.samples_root_mismatch: samples_root does not equal the Merkle root recomputed from the published raw/<batch_id>.jsonl.
codes.batch.raw_mismatch: The published raw/<batch_id>.jsonl does not match the batch: malformed, not one line per judged interval in time order, or an accepted or gate-refused interval whose payloads are missing or do not hash to its source.raw_sha256.
codes.batch.raw_missing: The raw payload file raw/<batch_id>.jsonl is not published next to the batch.
codes.batch.chain_break: prev_hash or seq does not continue the previous published batch, or the previous batch or the last accepted one does not rehash to its own sha256.
codes.batch.genesis_invalid: The first batch must have seq 0 and prev_hash of 64 zeros.
codes.batch.energy_mismatch: energy_mwh is not the sum of the intervals' basis energy.
codes.batch.cumulative_mismatch: cumulative_mwh is not the previous total plus energy_mwh; for a batch published as rejected, it is not the previous total unchanged (a refused batch carries no energy into the total).
codes.batch.count_mismatch: accepted_count, rejected_count and interval_count do not agree with the batch and the rejected ledger.
codes.batch.window_mismatch: ts_start or ts_end is not a canonical UTC timestamp, ts_end is before ts_start, or an interval lies outside [ts_start, ts_end].
codes.batch.interval_repeated: An interval starts at the same instant as one this batch or the last accepted batch already counted; the same energy is never counted twice.
codes.batch.interval_overlap: An interval starts before the previous interval ends, or the batch starts before the last accepted batch ends. A batch published as rejected never moves that point. Gaps are allowed; overlaps are not.
codes.batch.interval_off_grid: A contained interval's timestamps are not canonical UTC (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ), its ts_start is not a multiple of dt_s from the epoch, or its ts_end is not ts_start + dt_s.
codes.batch.site_mismatch: The batch, or an interval inside it, names a site_id or node_id other than the chain's (the last accepted batch's).
codes.batch.interval_rejected: An interval inside the batch fails the gates when re-run.
codes.batch.rejection_unproven: A rejected-ledger line for this batch passes the gates when re-run and carries no ingest reason.
codes.batch.unregistered_reason: A ledger line carries a reason code that is not registered.
codes.batch.spec_mismatch: The batch or a contained interval names a different spec or schema version.
codes.verifier.feed_unavailable: The verifier could not read the published batch from the public feed.
codes.verifier.not_published: The pending transaction refers to a batch that is not in the public feed.
codes.verifier.tx_mismatch: The pending transaction is not byte-identical to the one the verifier rebuilt from the published batch.
codes.verifier.hash_mismatch: The published batch no longer hashes to the value in the pending transaction.
codes.verifier.head_mismatch: Walking back from the batch through the published chain, rehashing every batch and re-adding every total (a batch never anchored carries the total forward unchanged), does not end at the on-chain anchor with the on-chain cumulative_mwh.
codes.verifier.walk_too_long: The walk back to the on-chain head stopped at its bound (168 published batches by default) before reaching the head. The check did not finish; nothing is known to be wrong. The usual cause is a long run of batches published as rejected, such as a node_id changed by mistake. The proposer blocks with the same code; operators raise the bound with --max-walk on both services.
